newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-READING SEND SOUTHAMPTON CRASHING OUT OF F.A.CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-READING SEND SOUTHAMPTON CRASHING OUT OF F.A.CUP.

text.p: First Division Reading caused the biggest upset of the day when they beat premier league Southampton 3-1 in the third round of the F.A. Cup on Saturday.

Southampton, bottom of the premier league with just one win in their last nine league matches, finished a nightmare afternoon with nine men after Francis Benali and Robbie Slater were sent off in the last 14 minutes.
Second division Wrexham held premier league West Ham to a 1-1 home draw, but it was a day of few upsets for the romantics to enjoy.
Sheffield Wednesday beat first division Grimsby 7-1, Middlesbrough, who had Craig Hignett sent off, beat third division Chester 6-0 and Nottingham Forest beat first division Ipswich 3-0.
There were also wins for Liverpool, who beat second division Burnley 1-0, Blackburn, who beat first division Port Vale by the same score, and Chelsea, who ousted first division West Brom 3-0.
In the only all-premier league clash, Arsenal and Sunderland drew 1-1.
Only 14 of the scheduled 27 matches were played because of bad weather. Four matches are due to go ahead on Sunday, with one other scheduled Sunday game already postponed.
